ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_friendl.zh: 是的！坚定不移，孔武有力。这就对了！
ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_friendl.en: Yes! Firm and robust. That's the way!
They are fools to oppose us.

ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_hostile.zh: 啊，是的。你们的表现很得体。

ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_hostile.en: Maybe there's hope for you yet.

ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_hostile.zh: 也许$COUNTRY$不管怎样还是适合效忠的。
ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_hostile.en: Maybe $COUNTRY$ is fit to serve after all.

ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_neutral.zh: 现在你们看到我们权威的正当性了。
ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_neutral.en: Now you see that our authority is just.
Our authority should not be questioned.

ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile.zh: 你们竟敢如此反抗？！蠢货！
ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile.en: You dare oppose us like this?! Fool!

ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile_.zh: 够了！我们会让你跪地不起的。会有这一天的。
ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile_.en: Enough! We'll make you kneel before long. All in due time.

ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile_.zh: 我们不会对这次僭越视而不见，更不可能原谅。
ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile_.en: This transgression will neither be overlooked, nor forgiven.

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly.zh: 你我言语，从善如流，不是吗？
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly.en: You agree with the undeniable merits of our resolution, no?

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_0.zh: 宗室相交，亲密无隙，不是吗？
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_0.en: Our dynasties work well together, do they not?

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_1.zh: $COUNTRY$已然赢得我方信任。我方确信，你方会在即将到来的投票中做出正确的选择。
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_1.en: The $COUNTRY$ has earned our trust. We are certain you will make the right choice in the upcoming vote.

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_2.zh: 星系需要$GREETER$与$COUNTRY$的坚强领导。让我们一道确保这项议案通过。
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_2.en: The galaxy needs the firm guidance of the $GREETER$ and the $COUNTRY$. Let us see this resolution through together.

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_3.zh: 我方的目标与$COUNTRY$一致。让我们驱散笼罩星系的混乱，让一切重归秩序之中。
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_3.en: Our goals align with those of the $COUNTRY$. Let us bring order to the chaos that reigns in the galaxy.

ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_4.zh: 我方向来景仰$COUNTRY$的领导。他们无疑必将看到我方议案的益处。
ethic_authoritarian_request_friendly_4.en: We have always admired the leadership of the $COUNTRY$. They will no doubt see the benefits of our resolution.

ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile.zh: 你方要在这件事上支持我方。不是的，这可不是在“请”求。
ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile.en: You will support us in this. No, that was not a friendly request.

ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_0.zh: 接受事物具有的天然层次吧，遵循我方对这件事情的领导。
ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_0.en: Accept the natural hierarchy of things and follow our lead in this.

ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_1.zh: 你们得在即将到来的投票中支持我方——我方要求你们这么做。
ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_1.en: Your support in the upcoming vote - we demand it.

ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_2.zh: 我们命令你方支持这项议案。
ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_2.en: We command you to support this resolution.

ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_3.zh: $COUNTRY$属于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中腐朽的势力。不要再传播你们的思想，毒害其他成员国的特使了。
ethic_authoritarian_request_hostile_3.en: The $COUNTRY$ is a corrupting influence in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. Do not spread your poison to the envoys of the other members.

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral.zh: 在这件事上支持我们。就现在。

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_0.zh: 我方领导，你方追随。兹事如此，事事皆然。
ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_0.en: We lead. You follow. In this matter, as in all others.

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_1.zh: 反抗事物的自然秩序只是徒劳。
ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_1.en: Opposing the natural order of things is a futile effort.

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_2.zh: 为了维护星系的秩序，这项议案必须通过。
ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_2.en: For the sake of maintaining galactic order, this resolution must be passed.

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_3.zh: 我方的意图是终止星海继续缓慢滑入无政府与混乱之中。这项议案只不过是长路上的一步。
ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_3.en: It is our intention to halt the galaxy's slow descent into anarchy and chaos. This resolution is but one step of the way.

ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_4.zh: 很快整个星海就将恢复和平与秩序。做好你分内的事，支持34-X号议案。
ethic_authoritarian_request_neutral_4.en: Soon peace and order will be restored throughout the galaxy. Do your part by supporting Resolution 34-X.

ethic_authoritarian_warning_hostile_0.zh: 你们不可在投票中反对我们。$GREETER$禁止这样的事。
ethic_authoritarian_warning_hostile_0.en: You will not vote against us. $GREETER$ forbids it.

ethic_authoritarian_warning_hostile_1.zh: 如果我们对你们接下来的投票结果感到不开心，你们也不会对后果感到开心的。
ethic_authoritarian_warning_hostile_1.en: If we don't enjoy your support in the upcoming vote, you won't enjoy the repercussions.

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_friendly.en: A true servant of the many.

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_hostile.zh: 或许你并非彻头彻尾的暴君……

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_hostile_0.zh: $COUNTRY$开始对公平的理念有感觉了吗？
ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_hostile_0.en: Is $COUNTRY$ warming to the idea of fairness?

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_hostile_1.zh: 我们承认，我们之前相信你们会表现的……更糟一些。
ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_hostile_1.en: Admittedly, we believed you'd perform... worse.

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_neutral_1.zh: 很高兴看到有人赞赏公平的概念。
ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_neutral_1.en: It's nice to see someone who appreciates fairness.

ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile.zh: 代表广大人民群众的利益，我们会与你为敌。
ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile.en: In the interest of the masses, we will oppose you.

ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile_0.zh: 起义就要到了。记住我们的话。
ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile_0.en: The uprising will come. Mark our words.

ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile_1.zh: 当无情的报应最终降临时，你会为这一天的事而懊悔的。
ethic_egalitarian_consequence_hostile_1.en: When unforgiving retribution finally comes, you will rue this day.

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly.zh: 与$COUNTRY$一道，我们可以做到这件事。
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly.en: Together with the $COUNTRY$, we can make this happen.

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_0.zh: $GREETER$相信$COUNTRY$会在这件事上支持我方的。
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_0.en: The $GREETER$ trusts that the $COUNTRY$ will support us in this.

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_1.zh: 光天化日之下，我们应当为正义与平等挺身而出，不是吗？
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_1.en: Is this not a fine day to stand united for justice and equality?

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_2.zh: 朋友们，我们将一道步入一个新的民主纪元……到了那时，整个星海都会是星系政治的一分子。
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_2.en: Together we will usher in a new democratic era, friends... one in which the entire galaxy shall partake.

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_3.zh: 这个机构里暗流涌动，它们与我们两个伟大国家的目标并不一致。我们必须彼此支持。
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_3.en: There are insidious forces at work within this institution who do not share the goals of our two great nations. We have to support each other.

ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_4.zh: 啊，$COUNTRY$！至少我方还有你们的支持可以倚靠！
ethic_egalitarian_request_friendly_4.en: Ah, the $COUNTRY$! Your support, at least, can be counted on!

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile.zh: 我估计要指望$COUNTRY$看到团结一致的价值是在犯傻。
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile.en: I suppose it would be silly to expect the $COUNTRY$ to see value in unity.

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_0.zh: 在这件事上支持我们吧。至少，现在开始在一些事情上寻求共识还为时不晚。
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_0.en: Support us in this. It is still not too late to find agreement in some things, at least.

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_1.zh: 尽管我们间存在差异，$GREETER$仍在与$COUNTRY$保持联系。请在这件事上同我方一道。
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_1.en: Despite our differences, the $GREETER$ is reaching out to the $COUNTRY$. Please join us in this.

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_2.zh: 这件事比我们$GREETER$与$COUNTRY$两国更为重要。让我们暂时放下彼此间的差异。
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_2.en: This is bigger than both the $GREETER$ and the $COUNTRY$. Let us put aside our differences for now.

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_3.zh: 不论你方对我方怎么认为，支持这项议案会是正确的举动。
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_3.en: Whatever you may think of us, supporting this resolution is the right move to make.

ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_4.zh: 我方是不是对$COUNTRY$有所误判？你国是不是比我方认为的要好上一些？你方会支持我方的议案吗？
ethic_egalitarian_request_hostile_4.en: Have we misjudged the $COUNTRY$? Are you a better nation than we thought? Will you support our resolution?

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral.zh: 为什么不用用你方的民主自由支持我方呢？
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral.en: Why not use your democratic freedom to support us?

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_0.zh: 选择权终究在你方手中，但请考虑在这件事上支持我方吧。
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_0.en: The choice is ultimately yours, but consider supporting us in this.

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_1.zh: $COUNTRY$中各位受人尊敬的同僚，我方呼吁你们依自己的公平感行事。
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_1.en: Esteemed colleagues in the $COUNTRY$, we appeal to your sense of fairness.

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_2.zh: 要记住，投票是你作为公民的责任。
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_2.en: Remember, voting is your civic duty.

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_3.zh: 我方恳求你方支持这项议案……它一定会改善数不清的、数以百万计的智慧生命的生活状况。
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_3.en: We implore you to support this resolution... it will surely improve the lot of untold millions of sapients.

ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_4.zh: 帮帮我们，让这个星系更加美好。
ethic_egalitarian_request_neutral_4.en: Help us make this galaxy a better place.

ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile.zh: 你是谁，敢于反对人民的意志？！
ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile.en: Who are you to oppose the will of the people?!

ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile_0.zh: 不要投票反对多数人，这会引起反抗的。
ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile_0.en: Do not vote against the masses. The masses will rebel.

ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile_1.zh: 是什么样的无情的怪物才会投票反对正义和平等？
ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile_1.en: What heartless monster would vote against justice and equality?

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_friendly_0.zh: 尽管并非我们中的一员，我们仍与$COUNTRY$感到亲近。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_friendly_0.en: Despite not being one of Us, we feel close to $COUNTRY$ now.

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_friendly_1.zh: 我们感谢你们的支持。我们中的每一个都这样想。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_friendly_1.en: We thank you for your support. We all do.

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile.zh: 看得出来，你们的文化无论如何还算是在正常运作。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile.en: We see now that your culture is still functioning after all.

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile_0.zh: 你的选择很明智。是靠逻辑推理还是纯粹走运？
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile_0.en: You chose wisely. Was this reason or just plain luck?

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile_1.zh: 或许你们的思维方式……尚可容忍。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_hostile_1.en: Perhaps your way of thinking is... tolerable.

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_neutral.zh: 感谢你们在这件事情中的选择。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_neutral.en: We thank you for your choice in this matter.

ethic_hivemind_appreciation_neutral_0.zh: 你们在这件事情中的立场值得赞赏。
ethic_hivemind_appreciation_neutral_0.en: Your standpoint in this matter is appreciated.

ethic_militarist_request_hostile_1.zh: $COUNTRY$证明自己荣誉感的机会到了——还是你们没有这份品质。
ethic_militarist_request_hostile_1.en: This is a chance for the $COUNTRY$ to prove its honor - or lack thereof.

ethic_militarist_request_hostile_2.zh: 十足的蠢蛋才会反对这项议案。
ethic_militarist_request_hostile_2.en: Only an utter fool would oppose this resolution.

ethic_militarist_request_hostile_3.zh: 哪怕$COUNTRY$的脑瘫也能意识到通过这项议案的价值吧。
ethic_militarist_request_hostile_3.en: Even the cretins in the $COUNTRY$ must see the value of passing this.

ethic_militarist_request_hostile_4.zh: 如果你方支持这项议案，我方对$COUNTRY$的轻蔑之意或许会有分毫的减轻……
ethic_militarist_request_hostile_4.en: Our contempt for the $COUNTRY$ might diminish somewhat if you support this resolution...

ethic_militarist_request_neutral.en: Support from the $COUNTRY$ would be appreciated.

ethic_militarist_request_neutral_1.zh: 你的支持能够展现你的力量。

ethic_militarist_request_neutral_2.zh: 当机立断，就在今朝。速予以我方你的支持！
ethic_militarist_request_neutral_2.en: The time for decisive action is now. Lend us your support!

ethic_militarist_request_neutral_3.zh: 我们从不用空洞的外交辞令打发你方……这项议案的价值不言而明。
ethic_militarist_request_neutral_3.en: We won't bore you with pointless diplomatic banalities... the value of this resolution should be self-evident.

ethic_militarist_request_neutral_4.zh: 这项议案不仅对于我方具有正当性，对于整个星系亦是如此。请你方提供支持。
ethic_militarist_request_neutral_4.en: This resolution is the right choice not only for us, but for the galaxy at large. Give it your support.

ethic_militarist_warning_hostile.zh: 不要投票反对我们。你知道原因的。
ethic_militarist_warning_hostile.en: Do not vote against us. You know why.

ethic_militarist_warning_hostile_0.zh: $GREETER$已经粉碎了少数反对派。不要违背我们。
ethic_militarist_warning_hostile_0.en: $GREETER$ have crushed opposition over less. Do not cross us.

ethic_militarist_warning_hostile_1.zh: 签署任何反对光荣的$GREETER$议案意味着签署了你们终结的开始。
ethic_militarist_warning_hostile_1.en: Signing anything in opposition of the honorable $GREETER$ is signing the beginning of your end.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_friendly.zh: 有人敢于想见在我们的时代结束一切暴力吗?
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_friendly.en: Dare one hope to see an end to violence in our time?

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_friendly_1.zh: 你们挽救了未来！还有什么目的会比这更纯粹呢？
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_friendly_1.en: You have saved the future! What purpose is more pure than that?

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile.zh: 谁会想到呢？纷乱的世界中会有和谐的一瞬。
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile.en: Who would've thought? A moment of harmony in a world of discord.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile_0.zh: 我们或许必须修订我们对$COUNTRY$的立场了：尚有希望。
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile_0.en: We may have to revise our stance on $COUNTRY$: not without hope.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile_1.zh: 我们之前推定你会辜负我们。在这件事情上，我们很高兴我们是错的。
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile_1.en: We assumed you'd fail us. In this matter, we are glad to be proven wrong.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral.zh: 很高兴看到$COUNTRY$懂得“和解”的涵义。
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral.en: Good to see that the concept of 'reconciliation' is known to $COUNTRY$.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral_0.zh: 感谢你们为星系一体化作出的努力。
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral_0.en: We appreciate your effort to create a galaxy of unity.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral_1.zh: 你们做了正确的事。这感觉难道不愉快吗？
ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral_1.en: You did the right thing. Doesn't it feel good?

ethic_pacifist_consequence_hostile_0.zh: 我们帮不了你。你已经无药可救。
ethic_pacifist_consequence_hostile_0.en: We cannot help you. You are beyond salvation.

ethic_pacifist_consequence_hostile_1.zh: 难道你们看不出你们道路的错误之处吗？！
ethic_pacifist_consequence_hostile_1.en: Do you not see the error of your ways?!

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly.zh: $GREETER$期待我们在$COUNTRY$有头脸的朋友们能够支持我们。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly.en: The $GREETER$ looks forward to the support from our valued friends in the $COUNTRY$.

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_0.zh: 我们相信$COUNTRY$会行正确之事。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_0.en: We are confident that the $COUNTRY$ will do the right thing.

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_1.zh: $GREETER$对于$COUNTRY$在接下来投票中的表现充满信心。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_1.en: The $GREETER$ has complete faith in the $COUNTRY$ for the upcoming vote.

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_2.zh: 让我们携手并进，将这片星系变得更为和平安全。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_2.en: Let us work together to make this galaxy a safer one.

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_3.zh: 请帮助我们，让其他人也看到这项议案的明智之处。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_3.en: Please help us make the others see the wisdom of this resolution.

ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_4.zh: 无论你投什么，$COUNTRY$都将被视作我们亲密的朋友。但是如果可以的话，请投赞成票。
ethic_pacifist_request_friendly_4.en: Regardless of how you vote, the $COUNTRY$ will always be considered our trusted friend. But please vote yes.

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile.zh: 做对事情。至少做对这一件事。
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile.en: Do the right thing. At least this once.

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_0.zh: 现在改变你的错误之道还不晚。
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_0.en: It is not to late to change your erroneous ways.

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_1.zh: 压制住你卑劣的本能，至少这一次选对。
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_1.en: Fight your base instincts and do the right thing for once.

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_2.zh: 反对这项议案，只能说明$COUNTRY$对星系其余有着卑鄙的企图。
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_2.en: Opposing this resolution will only prove the sinister motives of the $COUNTRY$ to the rest of the galaxy.

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_3.zh: 无论$COUNTRY$是否支持，我们都将通过这项议案！
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_3.en: We will see this resolution passed, with or without the support of the $COUNTRY$!

ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_4.zh: 如果你反对这项议案，历史将不会轻易放过$COUNTRY$。
ethic_pacifist_request_hostile_4.en: History will not look kindly on the $COUNTRY$ if you oppose this resolution.

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral.zh: 我们友善地请求你方在接下来的投票中予以支持。
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral.en: We are kindly requesting your support in the upcoming vote.

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_0.zh: 携手共进。还有比这更美好的词语吗？
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_0.en: Together. Is there a finer word?

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_1.zh: $GREETER$恭谦地请求你方在接下来的投票中施以援手。
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_1.en: The $GREETER$ humbly asks for your support in the upcoming vote.

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_2.zh: 我们相信$COUNTRY$会看到这项提议带来的益处。
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_2.en: We are certain that the $COUNTRY$ will see the merits of this proposal.

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_3.zh: 有了你方协助，我们将能够把[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]建设成和谐共存之处。
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_3.en: With your assistance, we can steer the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] towards peaceful coexistence.

ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_4.zh: 支持我们的议案，只要我们携手合作，战争和其他的苦难将被视作星系野蛮的一页被翻过。
ethic_pacifist_request_neutral_4.en: Support our resolution, and together we will make war and all the misery that comes with it a thing of the galaxy's barbaric past.

ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile.zh: 如果你反对我们，我们就会知道你们已经选定了暴力之路——它必将带去苦难。
ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile.en: If you vote against us, we will know you've chosen the path of violence - and it will lead to suffering.

ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile_0.zh: 你们不想看到$COUNTRY$沦为废墟，对吗？
ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile_0.en: You do not wish to see $COUNTRY$ fall into ruin, surely?

ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile_1.zh: 不要在接下来的投票中反对$GREETER$。不要自取灭亡。
ethic_pacifist_warning_hostile_1.en: Do not oppose $GREETER$ in the upcoming vote. It would be your failing.

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_friendly.zh: 你们感觉到了这一结果的正义性，不是吗？
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_friendly.en: You feel the righteousness of this outcome, don't you?

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_friendly.zh: 所以我们离乌托邦又进了一步。
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_friendly.en: And so we are one step closer to utopia.

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile.zh: 所以，你们已经开始赎罪了。

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile_.zh: 所以，这意味着$COUNTRY$希望拯救自身吗？
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile_.en: So, does this mean that $COUNTRY$ wishes to redeem itself?

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile_.zh: 很高兴看到，你们的救赎仍有商量的余地。
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile_.en: We're happy to see that your redemption is still on the table.

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_neutral.zh: 你能感觉到吗？作为整体的一部分的那种感觉？
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_neutral.en: Do you feel it now? What it is to be part of a whole?

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_neutral_.zh: 你们做了正确的选择。一个正当合理的选择。
ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_neutral_.en: You made the right choice. A righteous choice.

ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile.zh: 心灵中空无一物的滋味如何？
ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile.en: How does it feel to be dead inside?

ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile_0.zh: 任何形式的赎罪，都无法抵消如此的逾矩！
ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile_0.en: No atonement will ever make up for this transgression!

ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile_1.zh: 三千世界，无奇不有。可惜你再也体会不到了。
ethic_spiritualist_consequence_hostile_1.en: The universe is full of wonders. But you will never experience that.

ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly.zh: $COUNTRY$之前已经证明了他们的睿智，我们确信它会再次这么做。
ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly.en: The $COUNTRY$ has proven its wisdom before, and we are sure it will do so again.

ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_0.zh: 请在即将到来的投票中支持我们——我们比为俗事障目的文明知道的更多。
ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_0.en: Please support us in the upcoming vote - we know better than to be confused by worldly things.

ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_2.zh: 愿神灵对$COUNTRY$微笑。你会给予我们支持吗？
ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_2.en: May the spirits smile on the $COUNTRY$. Will you give us your support?

ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_3.zh: 作为灵魂的至亲，我们两个伟大的国家从来没有关系如此紧密过。
ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_3.en: The spiritual kinship between our two great empires is stronger than ever.

ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_4.zh: $COUNTRY$注定成就伟大的事业，正如$GREETER$一样。
ethic_spiritualist_request_friendly_4.en: The $COUNTRY$ is destined for great things, just as the $GREETER$ is.

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile.zh: 抛弃这些唯物主义和欲望的枷锁。支持我们，你通向智慧的道路将无比明亮。
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile.en: Lose those shackles of materialism and want. Support us and your path to wisdom shall become clear.

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_0.zh: $COUNTRY$在黑暗中苦苦挣扎，但是还是有找回光明的道路的一线生机。第一步就是要在接下来的投票中支持我们。
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_0.en: The $COUNTRY$ flounders in darkness, but may still find its way back to the light. The first step is to support us in the upcoming vote.

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_1.zh: 尽管你们之前犯了很多错误，我们祈祷$COUNTRY$能够辨明真正的道路并在接下来的投票中跟随我们。
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_1.en: Despite your many previous blunders, we pray that the $COUNTRY$ will recognize the true path to follow in the upcoming vote.

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_2.zh: 命运的阴谋造成了目前我们所处的境地……让我们被迫……寻求你们的支持。
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_2.en: The fates have conspired to bring about a situation where we are... compelled... to ask for your support.

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_3.zh: 救赎可能还没有从你的手中完全滑落。如果你们支持该议案，可能还有一线希望……
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_3.en: Salvation may not have slipped entirely out of your grasp just yet. If you support this resolution, there could still be hope...

ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_4.zh: $COUNTRY$最终会试图修正它们渎神的道路吗？这对你们还不是太晚。
ethic_spiritualist_request_hostile_4.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ finally make an attempt to mend its profane ways? It is not too late for you.

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral.zh: 你内心中或许有与我们立场一致的声音。请留心。
ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral.en: You probably have an inner voice that agrees with our standpoint. Heed it.

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_0.zh: 你知道为什么在投票中与我们保持一致会感觉是在做正确的事吗？因为那就是正确的事。
ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_0.en: Do you know why the notion of voting in alignment with us feels like the right thing to do? Because it is.

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_1.zh: 别在意琐碎的俗事，诸如数据或计划——遵循你的灵魂投票。
ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_1.en: Care not about menial things like data or plans - vote in accordance with your spirit.

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_2.zh: 我们不过是远比我们强大的事物的皮囊罢了。
ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_2.en: We are but vessels of something far greater than ourselves.

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_3.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ join the $GREETER$ on the path to salvation?

ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_4.zh: 审视你的内心，看到真相吧：采纳这项议案是前进的唯一方向。
ethic_spiritualist_request_neutral_4.en: Look within yourselves and see the truth: adopting this resolution is the only way forward.

ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile.zh: 你们微弱的头脑无法看到如果反对我们会有多少的麻烦蜂拥而至。
ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile.en: Your feeble mind cannot see the full range of woes coming your way if you oppose us.

ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile_0.en: Who are you to question divine right?!

ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile_1.zh: 不要反对我们。这将摧毁你们的灵魂，紧接着将是你们的肉体。
ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile_1.en: Do not oppose us. It will crush your spirit, and the body will follow.

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly.zh: 我们为自己是$COUNTRY$的盟友而真心自豪！
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly.en: We are truly proud to be allies to the $COUNTRY$!

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly_0.zh: 我们一分一秒都没有怀疑过你们的能力！
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly_0.en: We didn't doubt your ability for a second!

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly_1.zh: 宇宙或许在膨胀，但我们正日渐贴近。
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_friendly_1.en: Space may be expanding, but we're growing closer.

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile.zh: 我们很高兴，你们在这件事情里证明了我们对你们的评价是错误的。
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile.en: We are very glad you proved our opinion of you wrong in this matter.

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile_0.zh: 结果出乎意料，但我们很欢迎这一结果。
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile_0.en: This outcome was unexpected, but is very welcome.

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile_1.zh: 看到了吗？合作难道不是好得多吗？
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_hostile_1.en: See? Isn't cooperation so much nicer?

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_neutral.zh: 这是个愉悦的结果，不是吗？
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_neutral.en: This was a joyous turnout, was it not?

ethic_xenophile_appreciation_neutral_1.zh: 这可以成为一段美好友谊的开始。
ethic_xenophile_appreciation_neutral_1.en: This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

ethic_xenophile_consequence_hostile.zh: 我们已经正式解除与你们的友谊。

ethic_xenophile_consequence_hostile_0.zh: 你终将孑然一身。弱小又孤独。
ethic_xenophile_consequence_hostile_0.en: You will eventually stand alone. Weak and alone.

ethic_xenophile_consequence_hostile_1.zh: 这一次$GREETER$不会因有人离去而难过。
ethic_xenophile_consequence_hostile_1.en: For once $GREETER$ is not sad to see someone leave.

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly.zh: 让我们在即将到来的投票里并肩前行，向全星系展示团结的真谛！
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly.en: Let's stick together in the upcoming vote and show the galaxy what unity looks like!

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_0.zh: $GREETER$很乐意在这件事情上拥有$COUNTRY$的支持。
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_0.en: The $GREETER$ would love to have the support of the $COUNTRY$ in this matter.

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_1.zh: 我们两个伟大的帝国需要为一次琐碎的投票讨论可真是个遗憾，不是吗？
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_1.en: It would be a shame for a petty vote to come between our two great empires, no?

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_2.zh: 朋友，如果我们在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中互相支持，我们的成就将不可限量。
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_2.en: There is no limit to what we can accomplish if we support each other in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], friends.

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_3.zh: 不是很奇妙吗？这个星系论坛证明了星系中不同的物种可以通力合作，共同成就伟大的事业。
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_3.en: Isn't it wonderful? This galactic forum proves that the different species of the galaxy can build great things when working together.

ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_4.zh: 我方为星系中居住的全体开智物种改善星系的下一步计划就是这项议案。朋友，请向我方施以援手！
ethic_xenophile_request_friendly_4.en: This is the next step in our plan to improve this galaxy for all sapient species that inhabit it. Lend us your support, friends!

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile.zh: $COUNTRY$难道看不出团结一心的价值吗？
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile.en: Can the $COUNTRY$ not see the value in unity?

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_0.zh: 支持这项议案会是恢复我们两国关系所要迈出的第一步。
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_0.en: Supporting this resolution would be a first step in healing the relationship between our two nations.

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_1.zh: 不管怎样，$GREETER$仍想要与$COUNTRY$保持交流。请在这件事上支持我们。
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_1.en: Despite everything, the $GREETER$ would like to reach out to the $COUNTRY$. Please support us in this.

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_2.zh: 这会让我们都从中得利的……就算是$COUNTRY$也得明白这一点。
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_2.en: This will benefit us all... even the $COUNTRY$ has to see that.

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_3.zh: 这个论坛是为打破屏障而设的，为了促进在星海中共同生活的许多物种间的合作而设。
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_3.en: This forum is meant to break down barriers and foster cooperation between the many species that coinhabit the galaxy.

ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_4.zh: $COUNTRY$在担心什么？就这一次也好，你方就不能与我方相向而行吗？
ethic_xenophile_request_hostile_4.en: What is the $COUNTRY$ so afraid of? For once, can't you at least meet us halfway?

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral.zh: 嗨！$GREETER$愿你在接下来的投票中与我方一道。
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral.en: Hi! The $GREETER$ encourages you to join us in the upcoming vote.

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_0.zh: 你好，准朋友！你会在即将到来的投票中支持我方吗？
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_0.en: Hello, potential friend! Would you like to support us in the upcoming vote?

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_1.zh: 这可以成为一段美好友谊的开始。
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_1.en: This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_2.zh: 这次支持我方吧，我方会向全星系证明合作的价值。
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_2.en: Support us in this, and we will prove to the galaxy the value of cooperation.

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_3.zh: $COUNTRY$会支持我方努力把星海变成无论物种为何，对所有生物来说都更为美好的地方吗？
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_3.en: Will the $COUNTRY$ support us in our efforts to make this galaxy a better place for everyone, regardless of their species?

ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_4.zh: 不支持这项议案会违背[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]所基于的、最基本原则的精神。
ethic_xenophile_request_neutral_4.en: Not supporting this resolution would go against the spirit of the very tenets the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] was founded on.

ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile.zh: 如果你们投票反对我们，我不认为我们还能是朋友。
ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile.en: If you vote against us, I don't think we can be friends anymore.

ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile_0.zh: 真正的同胞是不会背叛他们的联盟的。
ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile_0.en: A real compatriot would not betray their allies.

ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile_1.zh: 请不要投票反对我们。我们会非常非常伤心的。
ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile_1.en: Please do not vote against us. It would be very, very sad.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly.zh: 明白了！我们可以共同努力，但要各自独立地努力。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly.en: See! We can work together, independently.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly_0.zh: 感谢你对我们的帮助，让我们不必在这件事情上花费更多时间。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly_0.en: We appreciate you helping us to not having to spend more time on this matter.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly_1.zh: $GREETER$很感激有人能看到文化完整性的价值。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_friendly_1.en: $GREETER$ is grateful that someone sees the value in cultural integrity.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_hostile.zh: 或许你们的文化并非毫无意义。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_hostile.en: Maybe that culture of yours isn't entirely without sense.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_hostile_0.zh: 谢谢。现在让我们清静一会儿吧。

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_hostile_1.zh: 我们真的没有想到你们会如此……通情达理。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_hostile_1.en: We really didn't think you would be that... sensible.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral.zh: 感谢你们的努力，应该是这样吧。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral.en: We appreciate your effort, I guess.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral_0.zh: 感谢你们的支持。现在我要离开这里了，请原谅。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral_0.en: Thank you for your support. If you excuse me, I need to get out of here.

ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral_1.zh: 所以你们有意保持你们的文化清白无瑕。这对你们来说是好事。
ethic_xenophobe_appreciation_neutral_1.en: So you have some interest in keeping your culture intact. Good for you.

ethic_xenophobe_consequence_hostile.zh: 我们就到此为止！总算摆脱了。

ethic_xenophobe_consequence_hostile_0.zh: 我们向来知道你们文化的低贱。
ethic_xenophobe_consequence_hostile_0.en: We always knew your culture was inferior.

ethic_xenophobe_consequence_hostile_1.zh: 想想看吧，我们居然曾经允许你们的文化与我们的相接近……
ethic_xenophobe_consequence_hostile_1.en: To think that we allowed your culture to even come near ours...

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly.zh: 在必要之时并肩努力对我们两个伟大帝国都有好处。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly.en: It is to the credit of both our great empires that we stand together when necessary.

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_0.zh: 啊，是$COUNTRY$！在这个外星粪坑里很少能找到值得我方尊重的人。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_0.en: Ah, the $COUNTRY$! It is rare to find someone worthy of our respect in this alien cesspool.

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_1.zh: 请求外人支持对我方来说是件烦心事，但$COUNTRY$被我方视作朋友。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_1.en: We do not enjoy asking for the support of outsiders, but the $COUNTRY$ are considered friends.

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_2.zh: 呆着这群异种中间令人心烦意乱，但是来自$COUNTRY$的任何代表都会被看作我方的朋友。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_2.en: It is unsettling to be here amongst all these xenos, but any representative from the $COUNTRY$ is to be considered a friend.

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_3.zh: 总算有通情达理的人了！这个地方充斥着所能想象到的、最为恶毒的异种，但能遇到$COUNTRY$的代表总是令人愉快。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_3.en: Finally, someone sensible! This place is infested with the vilest xenos imaginable, but it is always pleasant to meet with representatives of the $COUNTRY$.

ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_4.zh: 让我们共同努力，使[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]回归正轨。
ethic_xenophobe_request_friendly_4.en: Let us work together to put this [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] back on the right track.

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile.zh: 你方支持我方支持的越快，我们就能越早分道扬镳。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile.en: The faster you support us, the faster we can go our separate ways.

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_0.zh: 让我们把话挑明了说：$GREETER$不需要你方帮助。不过，若是你方在即将到来的投票中支持我方，我方也不是必须反对。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_0.en: Let us make something crystal clear: the $GREETER$ does not need your help. However, we would not necessarily be averse to your support in the upcoming vote...

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_1.zh: 我方政府下令，要我请求你方在即将到来的投票中协助我方。现在请原谅，我需要去找一下最近的卫生间在哪。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_1.en: My government has ordered me to ask for your assistance in the upcoming vote. Now please excuse me while I seek out the nearest sanitation chamber.

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_2.zh: 这个所谓的“[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]”不过是场外星闹剧，但我方会在其中扮演自己的角色……至少目前如此。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_2.en: This so-called "[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]" is an alien farce, but we shall play our part... for now.

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_3.zh: 若是这项议案没能通过，我方就有确凿的证据，证明一切其他外星物种正合谋对抗我方。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_3.en: If this resolution fails, we will have definite proof that all other alien species are conspiring against us.

ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_4.zh: 我之前从未见过如此多……不得体的生物会聚一处。这个[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]还真算个东西。
ethic_xenophobe_request_hostile_4.en: Never before have I seen so many... unseemly creatures gathered in one place. This [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] is truly something.

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral.zh: 这次支持我方就好，然后我方会满意地留下你方独自清静。
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral.en: Just support us in this, and then we will gladly leave you alone.

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_0.zh: 我方提议如下：你方在即将到来的投票中支持我方，然后你方就留下我方独自清静。你方同意吗？
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_0.en: We propose the following: you support us in the upcoming vote, and then you leave us alone. Are you in agreement?

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_1.zh: 被所有这些……生物……包围让我喘不过气，所以请别让我恳求你们支持了。
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_1.en: Being surrounded by all these... creatures... is a terrible strain, so please don't make me beg for your support.

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_2.zh: 看看这样一个外星人肆意混合、相互传播疾病的地方能出什么成果吧。至少现在，我方会好好利用这里的。
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_2.en: We shall see what good can come of a place like this, where aliens are free to intermingle and spread disease. For now, we will make the best of it.

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_3.zh: $GREETER$提出这项议案，是基于星系中所有其他帝国都足够可信，会遵守议案条款的假设之上的。
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_3.en: The $GREETER$ proposes this resolution, assuming the other empires of the galaxy can be trusted to adhere to its articles.

ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_4.zh: 或许与外星人合作而非嗤之以鼻确实有点意义。我们等等看吧。
ethic_xenophobe_request_neutral_4.en: Perhaps there is some merit to working with aliens instead of shunning them. We shall see.

ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile.zh: 不要投票反对我们——你们物种没有必要再用行动证明自己的劣等性了。
ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile.en: Do not vote against us; your species need not prove its inferiority any further.

ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile_0.zh: 投票反对我们是不明智的。即使对你的同胞来说也是不明智的。
ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile_0.en: It would be unwise to vote against us. Unwise even for your ilk.

ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile_1.zh: 不要证明你们的文化缺陷比你们已经有的更大了。不要反对我们。
ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile_1.en: Don't prove your cultural deficiencies more than you already have. Do not oppose us.

tech_adaptive_bureaucracy_desc_machine_i.zh: 相比早期型号，正电子处理器造价低廉、生产快速，有利于引入额外领袖单位。

tech_administrative_ai_desc_hive_mind.zh: 谋而后动。我们的思维将更上一层楼。
tech_administrative_ai_desc_hive_mind.en: Thought before action. Our Mind will evolve to ever greater heights.

tech_administrative_ai_desc_machine_inte.zh: 新的子例程能够增强我们的研究单位的注意力并消灭低效性。
tech_administrative_ai_desc_machine_inte.en: New subroutines will sharpen the focus of our research units and eliminate inefficiency.

tech_autocurating_vault_desc_corporate.zh: 这是一座巨大的金库，公开展示我们公司的许多辉煌的成果，员工将从这些成功的接管经历中汲取灵感，并从被收购的公司不能很好地融入我们更宏大的商业战略的失败经历中获得警示。
tech_autocurating_vault_desc_corporate.en: A massive vault with public displays of our corporation's many glorious acquisitions will let employees draw inspiration from successful takeovers, and take warning of what happens when acquired companies fail to properly mesh into our broader business strategy.

tech_autocurating_vault_desc_machine_int.zh: 所有的信息路径都导向枢纽，主级机械智能能够在空闲时随时分析编译数据。
tech_autocurating_vault_desc_machine_int.en: All informational pathways lead to the Hub, where the primary Machine Intelligence can analyze and interpret the data at its leisure.

tech_automated_exploration_desc_machine_.zh: 探索单位的算法更新换代后，勘察更快，并可在无中央机械智能指示时自主探索深空。
tech_automated_exploration_desc_machine_.en: Updated and more advanced algorithms will not only speed up surveying, but also permit our exploration assets to spend more time in deep space without continuous instructions from the central Machine Intelligence.

tech_centralized_command_desc_machine_in.zh: 所有机械都需要维护，对战体而言尤为甚至。专门的维修团队可以将磨损维持到最低，并减少修理费用。

tech_databank_uplinks_desc_hive_mind.zh: 我们发现了一种探索子个体的新奇用法：通过将其留在轨道上，并将其精神链接增幅到整个星球的范围，可以揭开新的探索渠道。即使是数十亿工人子个体的微弱突触，只要集合起来也可以产生累积效果。
tech_databank_uplinks_desc_hive_mind.en: A novel new use for explorator drones has been found: by keeping them in orbit and amplifying their mindlink planet-wide, new speculative paths of discovery are revealed. Even the feeble synapses of billions of worker drones, taken together, have a cumulative effect.
